Exception procedure
Before deviating, the requester records the policy clause, business reason, risks, compensating controls, owner, and proposed expiry in the Policy Register. sources.text:
Approval rules
An approver cannot approve their own expense, access, exception, or conduct case. The next uninvolved leader acts instead; the board representative acts for the CEO. Delegation must be written, time-limited, recorded in the Policy Register, and limited to the delegator's authority. Delegation never permits self-approval or bypasses Finance's independent payment verification.

Development practices
Keep secrets out of source code, use peer review, scan dependencies, and test with synthetic or de-identified data wherever possible. Production data in a test environment requires the data owner's and Privacy Lead's written approval and equivalent access controls.

sources.title: Acceptable Use and Digital Communications
sources.text: Digital communications must be appropriate to the sensitivity of the information being transmitted. Information classification requirements apply to electronic communications just as they apply to paper records. Employees must avoid sending confidential or restricted information to unapproved recipients or storing it in unsanctioned tools.

sources.title: External Communications and Brand Standards
sources.text: Use of social media and public digital channels must align with this policy and with unacceptable conduct policies. Employees may not publish or repost information that is defamatory, discriminatory, confidential, or otherwise harmful. sources.title: Privacy, Information Handling, and Records
sources.text:
Classification scheme
Public information is approved for external release. Internal information includes routine procedures and nonpublic operating notes. Confidential information includes contracts, nonpublic finances, and ordinary customer business data. Restricted information includes authentication secrets, sensitive personal information, and high-impact customer datasets. The information owner assigns the classification; mixed collections follow the highest applicable level.

sources.text:
Supplier comparison
Purchases above $5,000 require two comparable quotes or a documented sole-source justification approved by Finance and the CEO. Evaluate suitability, total cost, security, support, and exit terms rather than price alone. Disclose relationships under ETH-02 before participating in selection.

Approval matrix
All commitments require advance approval based on total expected value, including taxes, setup, renewals committed by the contract, and related purchases. Up to $500 requires manager approval. Above $500 through $5,000 requires manager and Finance approval. Above $5,000 requires manager, Finance, and CEO approval. Self-approval is prohibited; GOV-01 defines substitute approvers. Budget availability is necessary but does not replace approval.

The communications lead provides a verified internal update at least hourly for SEV1 and every four elapsed hours for SEV2 while active, even if the update is that investigation continues. sources.title: Incident Response and Crisis Communication

For SEV1 and SEV2, hold a review within five business days after stabilization. Examine detection, escalation, decisions, control gaps, customer impact, and what helped.
